race.comment: SAPLING (7) went around at $1.50 when resuming last start over this course and distance but after leading for home was swamped late and had to settle for third. Improved noticeably at the second run of last prep so all is not lost. EXTRA HEIGHTS (2) was five weeks between runs when a moderate sixth over this distance at Kembla last time out. Should tighten up a little following that hit-out. Keep an eye on track conditions as he needs the sting out to show his best. SKY DECK (3) finished less than two lengths from a smart one at the Kensington track two back then didn't perform as well as expected over today's journey at Kembla last time. Deserves the benefit of the doubt. GIRLS WEEKEND (5) returned in good order at Nowra recently and he generally improves as the prep wears on.
